title: From Transcription to Reformulation: Defining and Benchmarking Grounded Generative Speech Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.41292v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speech language models have expanded automatic speech recognition (ASR) from transcription to general speech-to-text generation. Yet existing benchmarks still assume a single ground-truth transcript per utterance, an assumption that struggles when models produce readable, formatted, or structured outputs. In this work, we introduce Grounded Generative Speech Recognition (GSR), reformulating speech recognition as generating semantically grounded text instead of a single transcript. We define a grounded reformulation space that characterizes all valid textual realizations supported by the input speech, and establish a four-level hierarchy of reformulation capabilities, including literal transcription, canonical reformulation, semantic reformulation and speech-grounded structuring. Based on this formulation, we present GSR-Bench, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate generative speech recognition systems beyond exact transc

translated_title: 从转录到重构：定义并基准测试有依据的生成式语音识别
translated_abstract: 语音语言模型已将自动语音识别（ASR）从单纯的转录扩展为通用的语音到文本生成。然而，现有基准测试仍然假设每段语音只有一个唯一的标准转录文本，当模型生成可读的、格式化的或结构化的输出时，这一假设便难以成立。在这项工作中，我们提出了有依据的生成式语音识别，将语音识别重新定义为生成语义上有依据的文本，而非单一的转录文本。我们定义了一个有依据的重构空间，用以刻画由输入语音所支持的所有有效文本实现形式，并建立了重构能力的四级层次结构，包括字面转录、规范化重构、语义重构和基于语音的结构化。基于这一表述，我们提出了GSR-Bench，这是首个旨在评估超越精确转录的生成式语音识别系统的综合性基准。
tldr: 该论文提出了“有依据的生成式语音识别”这一新范式，将语音识别从生成单一转录文本重新定义为生成语义上有依据的文本，建立了四级重构能力层次结构，并发布了首个综合评测基准GSR-Bench。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Grounded Generative Speech Recognition (GSR), a new paradigm that reformulates speech recognition as generating semantically grounded text rather than a single transcript, establishes a four-level hierarchy of reformulation capabilities, and presents GSR-Bench, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating generative speech recognition beyond exact transcription.
